correctness.rationale: Exact conditioning gives Z=I_m^2+(a-1)(z I_{m-2})^2 for all m>=2. The matching transforms of an irreducible Jacobi path give simple negative roots of both real factors when 0<=a<1; consecutive-path polynomial coprimality excludes shared roots. At a=1 the entire polynomial is a square; at a>1 it is a strictly positive sum of squares on the real line. Nonzero square-root pair coefficients follow from simplicity and coprimality; Vieta gives the odd-half-length distant root. Independent occupancy enumeration, 64 exact Sturm checks and 18 polynomial gcd cases passed the embedded verifier.

value.rationale: A single defect bond is a natural local perturbation of a one-dimensional repulsive lattice gas, and the exact all-size zeros are nontrivial finite-volume analytic invariants. The result completely distinguishes a repulsive regime with only simple negative zeros, one simultaneous coalescence parameter, and an attractive regime with no real zeros. It also identifies the odd-half-length root lost at complete central exclusion, supplying an exact singular degree boundary. No thermodynamic transition is claimed.
